description: Interface describing an auditable item stream.

dateCreated.description: The date/time of when the stream was created. json-ld namespace:schema

dateModified.description: The date/time of when the stream was modified. json-ld namespace:schema

organizationIdentity.description: The identity of the organization which controls the stream. json-ld namespace:twin-common

userIdentity.description: The identity of the user who created the stream. json-ld namespace:twin-common

annotationObject.description: The object to associate with the entry as JSON-LD. json-ld namespace:twin-common

proofId.description: The id of the immutable proof for the stream. json-ld type:schema:identifier

immutableInterval.description: After how many entries do we add immutable checks. json-ld type:schema:Integer

entries.description: Entries in the stream. json-ld container:set

cursor.description: The cursor for the stream entries. json-ld namespace:twin-common

verification.description: The verification of the stream. json-ld id
